# Step ids: an independent recompute and one id per failure per endpoint
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #170, sha256:2c410c2e5734a1672df8399328d24e4e3d7b3fc46521aa3ea54007a585ab20f9). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Done 2026-10-29 (independent recompute, one id per failure per endpoint, composite-phrase regression fixed, exact declaration line test; CI green on 613c8b5; Decider D119)
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** tooling (thin slice; split from card 161 by Decider D113)
- **Milestone:** Purpose: verifiability, preserved intent and reviewability
- **Source:** Decider D113 (2026-10-28): card 161 closes on its core outcome and the remaining review findings become small separate cards, each reviewable and revertable on its own. Two independent reviews of card 161 asked for this work.
- **Depends on:** 161
- **Story:** As Morgan, I want every step id to be recomputable from the Phrase source and unique, so that a log line carrying an id resolves to exactly one place.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given the Tasks source, When every record's stepId is recomputed independently from the documented rule (12 hexadecimal characters of SHA-256 over the normalised kind, Phrase line and name), Then each equals the id in the map
  2. Given a failure used by two endpoints, When the map is written, Then each use has its own id (the owning endpoint is part of what is hashed) and a test shows it
  3. Given the ids, When the same source is built from different directories and with CRLF line endings, Then the ids are identical

## Context

- Card 165 (the failure observer) reuses these ids, so it depends on this card. Follow docs/CODING_GUIDELINES.md: one required test per criterion, shown failing first; the generated C# output stays identical (the recorded orders hash stays 409bf3c6...).
